g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-301 Ribbon blender 6 cu ft (built in house) · rev B
SS 316 bar, cold finished, ASTM A276, Ø65 [2.56]
Ra 0.8 [32 µin] at bearings, seals and journal; Ra 1.6 elsewhere
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: SHAFT 1:2.5 (free end left, drive end right)

g.text: M16 x 32 [1.26] DEEP, DIN 332-D M16 centre
R1 [.04] max fillet, C1 x 45° on both ends

svg.text: Ø45 journal and Ø60 at bearings and boxes, after welding
flat bottom (drill + end mill), radial to the axis ±0.5°
ARM SOCKETS (x from the trough centre = 690 from the free end face)
1. Saw Ø65 bar to 1556, face both ends to 1550, centre drill. Rough turn Ø60 to Ø61 and Ø45 to Ø46 (leave 1 [.04] on diameters for finish turning after the weldment is complete).

2. After welding the agitator (P1-301-200), finish turn between the same centres: Ø60 h7 at both bearings and both packing zones (marked), Ø45 j6 journal, shoulder R1, chamfers. Polish packing zones to Ra 0.4.
3. Mill the keyway 14 N9 x 140 x t1 5.5 after finish turning; deburr. Drill and tap M16 x 32 in the drive end.
4. Mill the 14 arm sockets on the dividing head before welding, x and angle from the table (angles from top dead centre, CCW seen from the drive end, with the keyway at 0° as reference).

5. Lathe capacity: 1,560 [61.4] between centres, Ø300 swing over the carriage for the finish turning of the agitator (ribbon OD 550 needs a gap bed or a big lathe; otherwise finish the journals in a steady rest at each end).
